file_stem: RWB E1 026 Attach and search screen
title: Attach and search screen
goal: Let a case owner upload, list and search a case's documents by type and date from the case record
why: Documents stop living in e-mail and shared drives. Every upload is malware-scanned, typed, de-duplicated and logged before it is stored.
triggers: Case owner on SCR-30 Documents tab
ace_note: No ACE read. The screen works on Workbench cases and documents only.
stores: Intake blob container; quarantine on malware; Idempotency-Key store (24 h); DocumentStored event (EV-16)

functions.name: CaseDocumentQueryService
functions.does: list + search by type and date

rules: BR1: an upload carries a type from the table in force and source UPLOAD
BR2: every upload is malware-scanned first
BR6: the same file, type and case returns the existing document (R-UNI-40)
BR7: no decision log entry, no store (Principle 5)
risks: Decision log write fails -> 503, nothing stored (MSG-P7-003)
example: TEST-CO-01 uploads court-notice-0007.pdf (2 MB, COURT_NOTICE) to RW-2026-000123
Shown in the Documents tab within 5 s, 20 per page, newest first
